proposal.name: recording disk guard

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The guard starts in Init and follows the modeled caller events, space decisions and piece writes.

statements.name: RoomToStart
statements.says: A new Start is allowed exactly when the reading supplied for that Start succeeds and shows at least the start threshold.

statements.name: ContinuationDecision
statements.says: A piece reading or resumption check permits capture exactly when its reading succeeds with at least the reserve plus two maximum pieces and no stop was already requested.

statements.name: OwnPiecesPreserveReserve
statements.says: With only the running recording's pieces consuming space and the stated write bounds respected, those pieces never reduce free space below the reserve.

statements.name: OneStop
statements.says: The live guard emits at most one disk stop before capture ends for good or the guard crashes.

statements.name: StopIsLatched
statements.says: A requested disk stop remains requested until capture ends for good or the guard crashes.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every state value has its declared type and the parameters leave ample space between the start threshold and the stopping threshold.

statements.name: StartRefusalExplainsSpace
statements.says: Every refused Start supplies the menu with that Start's free-space reading or its failure and the required start threshold.

statements.name: UnsafeReadingRequestsStop
statements.says: A failed or insufficient piece or resumption reading has a disk stop requested in the same decision.

statements.name: StopEmissionIsExact
statements.says: A piece or resumption check emits a new stop exactly when its reading fails or falls below the stopping threshold and no stop was already requested.

statements.name: OrdinaryStopWithReason
statements.says: Every disk stop is the ordinary Stop command with the reason that the disk is nearly full.

statements.name: CaptureNeedsPermission
statements.says: Capture is admitted and runs only with an allowing decision and no requested disk stop.

statements.name: StartAtBoundary
statements.says: A Start reading exactly at the start threshold can lead to running capture.

statements.name: StartBelowBoundaryRefused
statements.says: A Start reading one unit below the start threshold can be refused.

statements.name: FailedStartRefused
statements.says: A failed Start reading can be refused.

statements.name: ContinueAtBoundary
statements.says: A running recording can continue at exactly the reserve plus two maximum pieces.

statements.name: StopJustBelowBoundary
statements.says: A running recording can request its stop at the first reading one unit below the stopping threshold.

statements.name: FailedRunningReadStops
statements.says: A failed reading during capture can request an ordinary disk stop.

statements.name: ResumeBelowStartLine
statements.says: An existing recording can resume at the stopping threshold even though it has less than the start threshold free.

statements.name: UnsafeResumeFinishesExisting
statements.says: An insufficient resumption reading can request finishing the existing recording without opening another piece.

statements.name: FailedResumeFinishesExisting
statements.says: A failed resumption reading can request finishing the existing recording without opening another piece.

statements.name: StopSurvivesGoodReading
statements.says: A later sufficient reading can leave a previous stop in force without emitting it again or permitting capture to resume.

statements.name: FinalPieceUsesLastRoom
statements.says: The final open piece can finish at exactly the reserve after a disk stop.

statements.name: FinishedAndReusable
statements.says: After capture ends for good the guard can be ready to decide a new Start with its old stop cleared.

statements.name: BugStaleStart
statements.says: A possible implementation grants a new Start using old free-space information despite that Start's insufficient or failed reading.

statements.name: BugStartAtReserve
statements.says: A possible implementation grants a new Start at the reserve instead of requiring the start threshold.

statements.name: BugFailedStartAllowed
statements.says: A possible implementation treats a failed Start reading as permission to start.

statements.name: BugOnlyOnePieceMargin
statements.says: A possible implementation continues with room for only one maximum piece above the reserve.

statements.name: BugFailedRunningReadAllowed
statements.says: A possible implementation continues recording after a failed running reading.

statements.name: BugResumeRequiresStartLine
statements.says: A possible implementation refuses safe resumption because the reading is below the new-Start threshold.

statements.name: BugDuplicateStop
statements.says: A possible implementation emits a second disk stop when the final piece's reading fails.

statements.name: BugWithdrawStop
statements.says: A possible implementation withdraws a requested disk stop when enough free space is available.

statements.name: BugWriteAfterFinalPiece
statements.says: A possible implementation writes another piece after the stopped recording's final piece has exhausted its safe margin.

proposal.module_text:
---- MODULE DiskGuard ----
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS StartBytes, ReserveBytes, MaxPieceBytes, MaxFreeBytes
VARIABLES phase, free, result, stopCount, command, reason

vars == <<phase, free, result, stopCount, command, reason>>

\* Byte quantities are nonnegative integers; a real GB is 1,000,000,000
\* bytes. The caller supplies the production constants. MaxFreeBytes is
\* only the finite exploration bound, not a production disk-size limit.
ParameterOK ==
    /\ StartBytes \in Nat /\ ReserveBytes \in Nat
    /\ MaxPieceBytes \in Nat /\ MaxFreeBytes \in Nat
    /\ ReserveBytes > 0
    /\ MaxPieceBytes > 0
    /\ StartBytes >= ReserveBytes + 4 * MaxPieceBytes
    /\ MaxFreeBytes > StartBytes

StopLine == ReserveBytes + 2 * MaxPieceBytes

\* Negative sentinels encode unavailable readings, never actual byte counts.
FailedReading == -1

NoReading == -2

Readings == FailedReading..MaxFreeBytes

StartRoom(r) == IF r = FailedReading THEN FALSE ELSE r >= StartBytes

RunningRoom(r) == IF r = FailedReading THEN FALSE ELSE r >= StopLine

EmptyResult ==
    [purpose |-> "none", reading |-> FailedReading, allowed |-> FALSE,
     wasStopped |-> FALSE, emitsStop |-> FALSE,
     noticeFree |-> NoReading, noticeNeed |-> 0]

Reply(p, r, stopped) ==
    [purpose |-> p,
     reading |-> r,
     allowed |-> IF p = "start" THEN StartRoom(r)
                ELSE RunningRoom(r) /\ ~stopped,
     wasStopped |-> stopped,
     emitsStop |-> p # "start" /\ ~RunningRoom(r) /\ ~stopped,
     noticeFree |-> IF p = "start" /\ ~StartRoom(r) THEN r ELSE NoReading,
     noticeNeed |-> IF p = "start" /\ ~StartRoom(r) THEN StartBytes ELSE 0]

TypeOK ==
    /\ ParameterOK
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "ready", "running", "reading", "suspended",
                 "stopping", "final-reading", "drained", "finish-existing"}
    /\ free \in 0..MaxFreeBytes
    /\ result \in [purpose : {"none", "start", "resume", "piece"},
                    reading : Readings, allowed : BOOLEAN,
                    wasStopped : BOOLEAN, emitsStop : BOOLEAN,
                    noticeFree : NoReading..MaxFreeBytes,
                    noticeNeed : {0, StartBytes}]
    /\ stopCount \in 0..2
    /\ command \in {"none", "Stop"}
    /\ reason \in {"none", "disk nearly full"}

RoomToStart ==
    result.purpose = "start" => result.allowed = StartRoom(result.reading)

ContinuationDecision ==
    result.purpose \in {"resume", "piece"} =>
        result.allowed = (RunningRoom(result.reading) /\ ~result.wasStopped)

OwnPiecesPreserveReserve ==
    phase \notin {"idle", "finish-existing"} => free >= ReserveBytes

OneStop == stopCount <= 1

StopIsLatched == stopCount > 0 => command = "Stop"

StartRefusalExplainsSpace ==
    result.purpose = "start" /\ ~result.allowed =>
        /\ result.noticeFree = result.reading
        /\ result.noticeNeed = StartBytes

UnsafeReadingRequestsStop ==
    result.purpose \in {"resume", "piece"} /\ ~RunningRoom(result.reading) =>
        command = "Stop"

StopEmissionIsExact ==
    result.purpose \in {"resume", "piece"} =>
        result.emitsStop = (~RunningRoom(result.reading) /\ ~result.wasStopped)

OrdinaryStopWithReason ==
    /\ (command = "Stop") = (reason = "disk nearly full")
    /\ result.emitsStop => command = "Stop"

CaptureNeedsPermission ==
    phase \in {"ready", "running", "reading"} =>
        result.allowed /\ command = "none"

StartAtBoundary ==
    phase = "running" /\ result.purpose = "start"
    /\ result.reading = StartBytes /\ result.allowed

StartBelowBoundaryRefused ==
    result.purpose = "start" /\ result.reading = StartBytes - 1
    /\ ~result.allowed

FailedStartRefused ==
    result.purpose = "start" /\ result.reading = FailedReading /\ ~result.allowed

ContinueAtBoundary ==
    phase = "running" /\ result.purpose = "piece"
    /\ result.reading = StopLine /\ result.allowed

StopJustBelowBoundary ==
    phase = "stopping" /\ result.purpose = "piece"
    /\ result.reading = StopLine - 1 /\ result.emitsStop

FailedRunningReadStops ==
    phase = "stopping" /\ result.purpose = "piece"
    /\ result.reading = FailedReading /\ result.emitsStop

ResumeBelowStartLine ==
    phase = "running" /\ result.purpose = "resume"
    /\ result.reading = StopLine /\ result.reading < StartBytes
    /\ result.allowed

UnsafeResumeFinishesExisting ==
    phase = "finish-existing" /\ result.purpose = "resume"
    /\ result.reading = StopLine - 1 /\ ~result.allowed /\ result.emitsStop

FailedResumeFinishesExisting ==
    phase = "finish-existing" /\ result.purpose = "resume"
    /\ result.reading = FailedReading /\ ~result.allowed /\ result.emitsStop

StopSurvivesGoodReading ==
    result.purpose = "resume" /\ RunningRoom(result.reading)
    /\ result.wasStopped /\ ~result.allowed /\ ~result.emitsStop
    /\ stopCount = 1 /\ command = "Stop"

FinalPieceUsesLastRoom ==
    phase = "final-reading" /\ free = ReserveBytes /\ command = "Stop"

FinishedAndReusable == phase = "idle" /\ free = ReserveBytes /\ stopCount = 0

\* phase is the caller's capture lifecycle, not detection of whether a
\* recording exists. free is an environment ledger for ONLY this capture's
\* pieces. stopCount is a proof monitor, not persisted state.
\* A successful read in this ledger-only execution reports free; failures
\* are independent inputs. Other disk users and finishing older recordings
\* are outside the piece-space guarantee. Reply is defined for every input,
\* including a successful reading below the reserve.
Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ free = 0
    /\ result = EmptyResult
    /\ stopCount = 0
    /\ command = "none"
    /\ reason = "none"

\* Checking a Start and supplying THAT Start's reading are one operation;
\* no cached reading grants a later Start permission.
CheckStart(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ result' = Reply("start", r, FALSE)
    /\ phase' = IF StartRoom(r) THEN "ready" ELSE "idle"
    /\ free' = IF r = FailedReading THEN 0 ELSE r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stopCount, command, reason>>

\* The caller identifies an existing recording, including after a crash.
\* A denied recovery has no open piece and finishes what already exists.
RecoverRecording(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ result' = Reply("resume", r, FALSE)
    /\ phase' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN "ready" ELSE "finish-existing"
    /\ free' = IF r = FailedReading THEN 0 ELSE r
    /\ stopCount' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN 0 ELSE 1
    /\ command' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN "none" ELSE "Stop"
    /\ reason' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN "none" ELSE "disk nearly full"

CaptureStarted ==
    /\ phase = "ready"
    /\ phase' = "running"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, result, stopCount, command, reason>>

\* One open piece can be written before the next report. At its close,
\* its successor is already open; it may still be written after a stop.
ClosePiece(n) ==
    /\ phase = "running"
    /\ free' = free - n
    /\ phase' = "reading"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<result, stopCount, command, reason>>

ReportPiece(ok) ==
    LET r == IF ok THEN free ELSE FailedReading
    IN
        /\ phase = "reading"
        /\ result' = Reply("piece", r, FALSE)
        /\ phase' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN "running" ELSE "stopping"
        /\ stopCount' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN 0 ELSE 1
        /\ command' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN "none" ELSE "Stop"
        /\ reason' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN "none" ELSE "disk nearly full"
        /\ UNCHANGED free

CloseFinalPiece(n) ==
    /\ phase = "stopping"
    /\ free' = free - n
    /\ phase' = "final-reading"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<result, stopCount, command, reason>>

ReportFinalPiece(ok) ==
    LET r == IF ok THEN free ELSE FailedReading
    IN
        /\ phase = "final-reading"
        /\ result' = Reply("piece", r, TRUE)
        /\ phase' = "drained"
        /\ UNCHANGED <<free, stopCount, command, reason>>

\* These are caller events. Closing a piece on an ordinary user Stop or
\* on an interruption is charged before capture is declared ended.
CallerEndsCapture(n) ==
    /\ phase \in {"running", "reading"}
    /\ free' = free - n
    /\ phase' = "drained"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<result, stopCount, command, reason>>

CaptureInterrupted(n) ==
    /\ phase \in {"running", "reading"}
    /\ free' = free - n
    /\ phase' = "suspended"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<result, stopCount, command, reason>>

ResumeCapture(ok) ==
    LET r == IF ok THEN free ELSE FailedReading
    IN
        /\ phase = "suspended"
        /\ result' = Reply("resume", r, FALSE)
        /\ phase' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN "ready" ELSE "finish-existing"
        /\ stopCount' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN 0 ELSE 1
        /\ command' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN "none" ELSE "Stop"
        /\ reason' = IF RunningRoom(r) THEN "none" ELSE "disk nearly full"
        /\ UNCHANGED free

RetryResumeAfterStop(ok) ==
    LET r == IF ok THEN free ELSE FailedReading
    IN
        /\ phase \in {"stopping", "final-reading", "drained", "finish-existing"}
        /\ command = "Stop"
        /\ result' = Reply("resume", r, TRUE)
        /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, free, stopCount, command, reason>>

CaptureEndedForGood ==
    /\ phase \in {"suspended", "final-reading", "drained", "finish-existing"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ result' = EmptyResult
    /\ stopCount' = 0
    /\ command' = "none"
    /\ reason' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED free

\* No guard state survives a crash; the caller supplies a fresh reading
\* and identifies an existing recording on recovery.
Crash ==
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ free' = 0
    /\ result' = EmptyResult
    /\ stopCount' = 0
    /\ command' = "none"
    /\ reason' = "none"

WaitForCaller == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ (\E r \in Readings : CheckStart(r) \/ RecoverRecording(r))
    \/ CaptureStarted
    \/ (\E n \in 0..MaxPieceBytes :
            ClosePiece(n) \/ CloseFinalPiece(n)
            \/ CallerEndsCapture(n) \/ CaptureInterrupted(n))
    \/ (\E ok \in BOOLEAN :
            ReportPiece(ok) \/ ReportFinalPiece(ok)
            \/ ResumeCapture(ok) \/ RetryResumeAfterStop(ok))
    \/ CaptureEndedForGood
    \/ Crash
    \/ WaitForCaller

\* Hypothetical mistakes, deliberately absent from Next.
StartUsingOldReading(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ free >= StartBytes
    /\ ~StartRoom(r)
    /\ result' = [Reply("start", r, FALSE) EXCEPT !.allowed = TRUE]
    /\ phase' = "ready"
    /\ free' = IF r = FailedReading THEN 0 ELSE r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stopCount, command, reason>>

BugStaleStart == \E r \in Readings : StartUsingOldReading(r)

StartUsingReserve(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ r \in ReserveBytes..(StartBytes - 1)
    /\ result' = [Reply("start", r, FALSE) EXCEPT !.allowed = TRUE]
    /\ phase' = "ready"
    /\ free' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stopCount, command, reason>>

BugStartAtReserve == \E r \in Readings : StartUsingReserve(r)

BugFailedStartAllowed ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ result' = [Reply("start", FailedReading, FALSE) EXCEPT !.allowed = TRUE]
    /\ phase' = "ready"
    /\ free' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stopCount, command, reason>>

BugOnlyOnePieceMargin ==
    /\ phase = "reading"
    /\ free >= ReserveBytes + MaxPieceBytes
    /\ free < StopLine
    /\ result' = [Reply("piece", free, FALSE) EXCEPT
                      !.allowed = TRUE, !.emitsStop = FALSE]
    /\ phase' = "running"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, stopCount, command, reason>>

BugFailedRunningReadAllowed ==
    /\ phase = "reading"
    /\ result' = [Reply("piece", FailedReading, FALSE) EXCEPT
                      !.allowed = TRUE, !.emitsStop = FALSE]
    /\ phase' = "running"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, stopCount, command, reason>>

BugResumeRequiresStartLine ==
    /\ phase = "suspended"
    /\ free >= StopLine /\ free < StartBytes
    /\ result' = [Reply("resume", free, FALSE) EXCEPT
                      !.allowed = FALSE, !.emitsStop = TRUE]
    /\ phase' = "finish-existing"
    /\ stopCount' = 1
    /\ command' = "Stop"
    /\ reason' = "disk nearly full"
    /\ UNCHANGED free

BugDuplicateStop ==
    /\ phase = "final-reading"
    /\ command = "Stop"
    /\ result' = [Reply("piece", FailedReading, TRUE) EXCEPT !.emitsStop = TRUE]
    /\ phase' = "drained"
    /\ stopCount' = stopCount + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, command, reason>>

BugWithdrawStop ==
    /\ command = "Stop"
    /\ free >= StopLine
    /\ command' = "none"
    /\ reason' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, free, result, stopCount>>

BugWriteAfterFinalPiece ==
    /\ phase = "final-reading"
    /\ free = ReserveBytes
    /\ free' = free - MaxPieceBytes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, result, stopCount, command, reason>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====
proposal.view:
{
  "version": 1,
  "state": [
    {"id": "idle", "when": {"eq": [{"var": "phase"}, "\"idle\""]}, "label": "Waiting for Start or recovery"},
    {"id": "ready", "when": {"eq": [{"var": "phase"}, "\"ready\""]}, "label": "Capture permitted"},
    {"id": "running", "when": {"eq": [{"var": "phase"}, "\"running\""]}, "label": "Capture running"},
    {"id": "reading", "when": {"eq": [{"var": "phase"}, "\"reading\""]}, "label": "Piece closed; next piece already open"},
    {"id": "suspended", "when": {"eq": [{"var": "phase"}, "\"suspended\""]}, "label": "Capture interrupted; fresh resumption check required"},
    {"id": "stopping", "when": {"eq": [{"var": "phase"}, "\"stopping\""]}, "label": "Ordinary disk stop requested; final piece open"},
    {"id": "final_reading", "when": {"eq": [{"var": "phase"}, "\"final-reading\""]}, "label": "Final piece closed; stop remains requested"},
    {"id": "drained", "when": {"eq": [{"var": "phase"}, "\"drained\""]}, "label": "Capture closed; awaiting end notification"},
    {"id": "finish_existing", "when": {"eq": [{"var": "phase"}, "\"finish-existing\""]}, "label": "Resumption refused; finish the existing recording"},
    {"id": "all", "when": true, "label": "Disk guard"}
  ],
  "step": [
    {"id": "start", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "CheckStart"]}, "label": "Decide this Start from its fresh reading"},
    {"id": "recover", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "RecoverRecording"]}, "label": "Check an existing recording for recovery"},
    {"id": "started", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "CaptureStarted"]}, "label": "Caller reports capture running"},
    {"id": "piece", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "ClosePiece"]}, "label": "Write and close one bounded piece"},
    {"id": "report", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "ReportPiece"]}, "label": "Decide from the piece-close reading"},
    {"id": "final_piece", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "CloseFinalPiece"]}, "label": "Close only the piece open at the stop"},
    {"id": "final_report", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "ReportFinalPiece"]}, "label": "Process final reading without repeating the stop"},
    {"id": "caller_ends", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "CallerEndsCapture"]}, "label": "Caller finishes capture and its open piece"},
    {"id": "interrupt", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "CaptureInterrupted"]}, "label": "Capture ends by itself with its last piece closed"},
    {"id": "resume", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "ResumeCapture"]}, "label": "Check a fresh reading before resuming"},
    {"id": "latched", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "RetryResumeAfterStop"]}, "label": "Keep the requested stop despite another reading"},
    {"id": "ended", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "CaptureEndedForGood"]}, "label": "Caller confirms capture ended for good"},
    {"id": "crash", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "Crash"]}, "label": "Crash loses the guard's volatile state"},
    {"id": "wait", "when": {"eq": [{"action": true}, "WaitForCaller"]}, "label": "Wait for a caller event"},
    {"id": "all", "when": true, "label": "Disk guard step"}
  ]
}
